basis: The occupancy classes of the loss foundation (E169): the building-use classes of the published depth-damage curves the platform offers (Huizinga, de Moel & Szewczyk 2017, JRC Technical Report JRC105688, 'Global flood depth-damage functions'), so an asset's stated use selects its curve within the family the institution adopts. The class names are verified against the report when its curves are ingested.

classes.commercial: buildings for trade and services: offices, shops, retail
classes.industrial: buildings for production: factories, plants, workshops

crosswalk_basis: Asset types whose use is unambiguous are read as their class; every other type needs the institution's statement of occupancy (a warehouse, a hotel or a power plant is classed differently by different curve sets, so the platform does not choose).
